documents.title: Runbook: WebSphere Application Server on Linux — process limits for application servers
documents.body:
Runbook for WebSphere Application Server (WAS) hosts on Linux.

PROCESS LIMITS

Even when investigating native OutOfMemory errors such as "Failed to create a thread" on Linux, keep nproc (ulimit -u) at the RHEL default of 1024 for the WAS user. Do not raise the nproc limit on application servers; instead inspect leaked threads in the JVM.

Applies to: WebSphere Application Server (WAS), Linux hosts managed by the platform team.
